info.title: Finance Tracker API
info.description: Documentation for API of Finance Tracker

get.description: Return a friendly welcome message.

post.description: Authenticate user and set refresh token cookie.
Verify a newly registered user email with a one-time token.
Send a fresh verification email when the account still needs email confirmation.

get.description: Rotate refresh token cookie and return a new access token.

post.description: Clear refresh token cookie and invalidate session.

get.description: Return the authenticated user profile.
Return all users.
Return a single user by id. Requires authentication.

delete.description: Delete a user by id. Requires authentication.

post.description: Create a test user and seed sample transactions. Requires authentication.

get.description: Return all accounts for the authenticated user.

post.description: Create a new account for the authenticated user.

get.description: Return all favorite accounts for the authenticated user.
Return a single account by id.

post.description: Mark account as favorite for the authenticated user.

delete.description: Remove account from favorites for the authenticated user.

get.description: Return all categories for the authenticated user.

post.description: Create a new category for the authenticated user.

get.description: Return all favorite categories for the authenticated user.
Return a single category by id.

post.description: Mark category as favorite for the authenticated user.

delete.description: Remove category from favorites for the authenticated user.

get.description: Return all payment methods for the authenticated user.

post.description: Create a new payment method for the authenticated user.

get.description: Return all favorite payment methods for the authenticated user.
Return a single payment method by id.

put.description: Update a payment method by id.

delete.description: Delete a payment method by id.

post.description: Mark payment method as favorite for the authenticated user.

delete.description: Remove payment method from favorites for the authenticated user.

get.description: Return list of currencies with their codes and names.
Return paginated transactions for the authenticated user.

delete.description: Move all active transactions for the authenticated user to trash.

get.description: Return paginated trashed transactions for the authenticated user.

delete.description: Permanently delete all trashed transactions for the authenticated user.

get.description: Export filtered transactions to CSV. Pagination parameters are accepted but ignored.
Return totals grouped by currency and transaction type.
Return transaction balances grouped by account and currency.
Return statistics grouped by time period.
Return a single trashed transaction by id.

delete.description: Permanently delete a trashed transaction by id. Linked transaction is deleted as well.

post.description: Restore a trashed transaction by id. Linked transaction is restored as well.
Restore all trashed transactions for the authenticated user.

get.description: Return a single transaction by id.

delete.description: Move a transaction to trash by id.

post.description: Create multiple transactions at once. Standard transactions create one entry, exchange and transfer transactions create linked pairs.
Create an exchange transaction (two linked entries).
Create a transfer transaction (two linked entries).

put.description: Update a standard transaction by id.
Update a transfer transaction by id.
Update an exchange transaction by id.

post.description: Create test transactions for the authenticated user (only if none exist).
